lines.en: Whispers in the dark
Fire swirls around it
Devouring the surrounding darkness

lines.zh: 黑金里出来，我身上冒烟。
lines.en: Out of dark gold, smoke curling off me.
Flames lick its skin

lines.zh: 眼睛闪烁着恶毒的光芒
lines.en: Eyes glowing with malice
Waving its claws

lines.zh: 黑暗中浮现扭曲的身影
lines.en: Twisted figure appears in the dark
Chasing the player's footsteps
Demon of Darkness moves

lines.zh: 黑金的碎屑从身上掉落
lines.en: Black-gold shards fall off my body.
I walk across the scorched earth.
Standing silently
Embracing the darkness
Staring into the distance
Looking into the abyss
Occasionally opening its mouth
Seems to be thinking
Flames dancing inside
Lost in dark fantasies
Frowns occasionally
The black-gold realm is stiflingly quiet.
Counting screams in the distance.
I draw my claws back into the dark.
Licking the cracks in my black gold.
Black gold turns slowly inside me.
I stare at my own palm.
No wind in the dark, only me.
Staring at the player
Noted the player

lines.zh: 似乎闻到了玩家的味道
lines.en: Seems to smell the player

lines.zh: 你身上，有黑金之魂的光。
lines.en: You carry the glow of a black-gold soul.
Maliciously staring at the player
Hostile towards the player

lines.zh: 黑金世界的光，照出你的轮廓。
lines.en: The blackened light picks out your outline.
Seems to be evaluating the player
Frowning intensely
Curious about the player
Your soul is far too loud.
I count the lights on you.
The fire in your hand is not bright enough.
I am weighing what you are worth.
A piercing scream cuts through the darkness!
Your power struck me!
Your luck has run out!

lines.zh: 黑暗吞噬了我的一部分！
lines.en: Darkness devours a part of me!
You dealt a deep wound!
My strength wanes…
My magic is faltering!
My soul trembles!
I can't keep this up!
You challenge my limits!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶，弱小凡人，我黑暗之魂让你屈服。
lines.en: Sssss, little mortal, my darkness will bend you to my will.

lines.zh: 吞噬你的灵魂，融入我的黑金之魂。
lines.en: Devour your soul, merge it with my Black Gold Spirit.

lines.zh: 你的恐惧是力量，让黑暗吞噬你吧。
lines.en: Your fear is power, let darkness consume you.

lines.zh: 在黑金的世界中，你只是微不足道的存在。
lines.en: In the realm of Black Gold, you are but an insignificant speck.

lines.zh: 你身上散发的光芒太刺眼，让我不适。
lines.en: The light emanating from you is blinding, I must remove it.

lines.zh: 黑暗中我的力量最强大，你无力反抗。
lines.en: In the darkness, my power is greatest, and you cannot resist.

lines.zh: 我的黑金之魂会给予你力量，或是吞噬你。
lines.en: My Black Gold Spirit will either empower or devour you.

lines.zh: 感受到我的气息了吗？你无法逃脱我的掌控。
lines.en: Feel my presence? You cannot escape my grasp.

lines.zh: 黑暗恶魔的魔力，足以摧毁你的意志。
lines.en: The magic of the Demon of Darkness can shatter your will.

lines.zh: 你的火焰无法与我黑暗之火相比。
lines.en: Your flames cannot compare to my dark fire.
Bang! No mercy between us!

lines.zh: 你的力量不足以击倒我！
lines.en: Your strength is not enough to defeat me!

lines.zh: 我不会轻易让位给你的力量。
lines.en: I will not yield to your power easily.

lines.zh: 你的撞击只能加速我的毁灭。
lines.en: Your collision only accelerates my destruction.

lines.zh: 碰撞吧，我的力量足以碾碎你。
lines.en: Collide with me, my power can crush you.
You cannot harm me in the slightest.

lines.zh: 我的黑金之魂坚不可摧。
lines.en: My Black Gold Spirit is unbreakable.

lines.zh: 你的力量不足以改变我的命运。
lines.en: Your strength is not enough to alter my fate.

lines.zh: 撞击只会让我更加愤怒。
lines.en: The collision only makes me angrier.

lines.zh: 即使碰撞也无法阻止我的前进。
lines.en: No collision can stop my progress.

lines.zh: 我的黑金之魂渴望新的生命。
lines.en: My Black Gold Spirit craves new life.

lines.zh: 你将成为我的同伴，共同生存。
lines.en: You will be my companion, surviving together.

lines.zh: 你的力量与我匹配，可以结合。
lines.en: Your strength matches mine, we can combine.

lines.zh: 我们的灵魂将融合成一股力量。
lines.en: Our souls will fuse into one power.

lines.zh: 我的黑金之魂将引导你进化。
lines.en: My Black Gold Spirit will guide your evolution.

lines.zh: 只有与我结合，才能真正强大。
lines.en: Only by uniting with me can you truly become strong.

lines.zh: 我们的结合是黑暗的胜利。
lines.en: Our union is a triumph of darkness.

lines.zh: 我的力量将重塑你的存在。
lines.en: My power will reforge your being.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中，我们变得更强。
lines.en: In the darkness, we become stronger.
Our souls will coexist.

lines.zh: 黑金之魂在我心中跳动！
lines.en: The Black Gold Soul resonates within me!
Suck its soul and make it yours!
This is my trophy!
Black Gold Soul, my treasure!
Soul fragments, my power!
Swallow the soul, grow stronger!

lines.zh: 它的力量在我体内燃烧！
lines.en: Its power burns within me!
The soul fire guides my path!

lines.zh: 吞下它的灵魂，我将更强！
lines.en: Swallow its soul and I will grow stronger!

lines.zh: 黑金之魂，我的力量源泉！
lines.en: Black Gold Soul, my power source!
Prey ahead!
Find the next prey!
The prey's scent is so sweet!
Prey, my meal!
Prey is about to be caught!
The prey's scent is near!
Prey, my next target!
Capture prey, my instinct!

lines.zh: 猎物就在我的视野中，黑金之魂在哭。
lines.en: Prey in my sight, and the black-metal souls weep.
Prey, my food!
My black gold recognizes you.
You will not leave this dark today.

lines.zh: 黑暗里，我的火球已经点着。
lines.en: In the dark, my fireball is already lit.
Target the enemy and destroy!
Lock target and attack!
Target the enemy, prepare to shoot!
Target the prey, precise shot!
Target the weak point, one shot kills!
Target accurately, without fail!
Target the enemy, crush them!
Target the weak point, fatal shot!
Darkness gathers between my fingers.
I press in, step by step.
Your shadow kneels first.
Black gold cuts through your armor.
Sssss, you can't escape!
Feel the taste of darkness!
Devour your soul!
Pain will accompany you!
Darkness envelops you!
I wield the source of darkness!
You've touched forbidden things!
Burn, your flesh!
Sink into endless darkness!
Dark soul, my reward!
I emerge from darkness!
Darkness is my home!
Black gold world, my domain!

lines.zh: 黑金世界的门，我推开了。
lines.en: I pushed open the gate of the black-gold world.
Find my presence in the dark!
Wait for you in the dark!
I am the embodiment of darkness!

lines.zh: 从黑金的裂缝里爬出来。
lines.en: Crawling out of a black-gold crack.
Guardian of the darkness!
I am the legend of darkness!
A gate splits open in the black-gold world.

lines.zh: 我从地底的暗里升上来
lines.en: I rise out of the underground dark.
Fallen black gold begins to glow.
The dark here knows me.

lines.zh: 痛苦的尖叫穿透黑暗，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: A piercing scream cuts through the darkness! — and the fire makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我被你的力量击中了，摔落的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Your power struck me! — and the fall makes it worse.

lines.zh: 你的好运已经用完了，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Your luck has run out! — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 黑暗吞噬了我的一部分，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Darkness devours a part of me! — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 你给我的伤害太深了，中箭的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: You dealt a deep wound! — and the projectile makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我的力量开始减弱了，中魔法的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My strength wanes… — and the magic makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我的魔法被削弱了，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My magic is faltering! — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我的灵魂在颤抖，遭雷击的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My soul trembles! — and the lightning makes it worse.

lines.zh: 不能再这样下去了，坠入虚空的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I can't keep this up! — and the void makes it worse.
